data.current_description:
Allows you to increase or decrease the authorised amount after the initial authorisation has taken place. This functionality enables for example tipping, improving the chances your authorisation will be valid, or charging the shopper when they have already left the merchant premises.

 This endpoint is part of our [classic API integration](https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments/classic-integrations/api-integration-ecommerce). If you have a [newer integration](https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments), and are doing:
* [Asynchronous adjustments](https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments/adjust-authorisation#asynchronous-or-synchronous-adjustment), use the [`/payments/{paymentPspReference}/amountUpdates`](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/CheckoutService/v67/post/payments/{paymentPspReference}/amountUpdates) endpoint on Checkout API.
* [Synchronous adjustments](https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments/adjust-authorisation#asynchronous-or-synchronous-adjustment), use this endpoint.
data.summary_suggestion: Adjust the authorised amount after initial authorisation
data.description_suggestion: Adjusts the authorised amount after the initial authorisation has taken place. This can be used for tipping, improving authorisation validity, or charging the shopper after they have left the premises. Requires authentication. Returns a unique reference for the adjustment request. Note: If using a newer integration, refer to the appropriate endpoint for asynchronous or synchronous adjustments.
